info.title: less
info.description: Native terminal pager with ANSI colour, search, follow mode, and modern defaults. A cross-platform less replacement.

options.name: -S
options.description: Chop (truncate) long lines instead of wrapping

options.name: -F
options.description: Quit if content fits on one screen (default: on)

options.name: -X
options.description: Don't clear screen on exit (default: on)

options.name: -i
options.description: Case-insensitive search (smart case: sensitive if pattern has uppercase)

options.name: --describe
options.description: Structured JSON metadata for AI agents

options.name: --color
options.description:
Coloured output: auto (default when omitted), always, or never
Wildcards (Windows):
On Windows, * and ? in path arguments are expanded by less itself
(cmd and PowerShell don't expand them). [...] is matched literally and
'**' is not supported. A pattern matching nothing is passed through
unchanged. In cmd, quote the pattern to suppress expansion.
